SET VARIABLE PREFERRED_CURRENCY='User Preferred Currency 1';SELECT saw_0, saw_1, saw_2, saw_3 FROM ((SELECT "Accrual Plan"."Accrual Plan Name" saw_0, CAST('Not Booked' as CHAR(10)) saw_1, IFNULL("Front-Loaded Plan"."Accrual Balance", value) saw_2, CAST(1 as INT) saw_3 FROM "Workforce Management - Accrual Real Time" WHERE ("Time"."Calendar Year" IN (2018,  2017)) AND ("Worker"."User Name" =  VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION."USER"))) UNION (SELECT "Absence Type"."Absence Type Name" saw_0, "Assignment Absences Details"."Absence Status" saw_1, "Assignment Absences"."Leave Duration" saw_2, CAST(2 as INT) saw_3 FROM "Workforce Management - Absence Real Time" WHERE (DESCRIPTOR_IDOF("Workforce Management - Absence Real Time"."Assignment Absences Details"."Absence Status") IN ('AWAITING', 'INPROGRESS', 'SCHEDULED')) AND ("Time"."Calendar Year" IN (2018,  2017)) AND ("Worker"."User Name" =  VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION."USER")))) t1 ORDER BY saw_3 DESC

select	 "Worker"."Employee Display Name" as "Employee Display Name",
         CURRENT_DATE "TodayDate",
	 "Worker"."Employee Mailing Address Line1" as "Employee Mailing Address Line1",
	 "Location"."Worker Location Name" as "Worker Location Name",
	 "Time"."Month" as "Month",
	 "Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Due" as "Amount Due",
	 "Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Paid" as "Amount Paid",
	 "Fact - Benefits Billing Charges"."Total Bill Amount" as "Total Bill Amount",
	 ("Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Due"-"Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Paid") as "Bill Outstanding Amount",
	 ("Fact - Benefits Billing Charges"."Total Bill Amount"/ Count ( distinct"Billing Charges"."Bill Number")) as "Average Billing",
	 REPORT_AGGREGATE("Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Due"-"Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Paid" BY "Worker"."Employee Display Name") as "Employee Outstadning",
	 REPORT_SUM("Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Paid" BY "Worker"."Employee Display Name") as "Total Paid" 
from	"Benefits - Billing Real Time"."Fact - Benefits Billing Charges" "Fact - Benefits Billing Charges",
	"Benefits - Billing Real Time"."Fact - Benefits Billing Payments" "Fact - Benefits Billing Payments",
	"Benefits - Billing Real Time"."Time" "Time",
	"Benefits - Billing Real Time"."Location" "Location",
	"Benefits - Billing Real Time"."Worker" "Worker",
	"Benefits - Billing Real Time"."Billing Charges" "Billing Charges"
 where 	 "Worker"."Employee Display Name" =:P_Emp AND
 (("Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Due" - "Fact - Benefits Billing Payments"."Amount Paid" IS NOT NULL) AND (("Fact - Benefits Billing Charges"."Total Bill Amount") IS NOT NULL))

Select Promotions.s_6 empName,
Promotions.s_3 PYear,
Performance.s_2 postPromotionPerformanced,
Performance.s_1 postPromotionPerformance,
Performance2.s_1 prePromotionPerformance,
(Performance.s_1  - Performance2.s_1 ) delta

from
(SELECT
   0 s_0,
   "Workforce Management - Worker Assignment Event Real Time"."Department"."Department Name" s_1,
   "Workforce Management - Worker Assignment Event Real Time"."HR Action"."Action Type" s_2,
   "Workforce Management - Worker Assignment Event Real Time"."Time"."Calendar Year" s_3,
   "Workforce Management - Worker Assignment Event Real Time"."Worker Legislation"."Territory Short Name" s_4,
   "Workforce Management - Worker Assignment Event Real Time"."Worker"."Employee Gender" s_5,

   "Workforce Management - Worker Assignment Event Real Time"."Worker"."Person ID" s_7
FROM "Workforce Management - Worker Assignment Event Real Time"
WHERE
((("HR Action"."Action Type" LIKE '%Promote%' OR "HR Action"."Action Type" LIKE '%Salary Change%')) AND ("Time"."Calendar Year" > 2010))) Promotions,




(SELECT
   0 s_0,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."-  Performance Rating Level"."Numeric Rating" s_1,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."-  Performance Rating Level"."Rating Short Description" s_2,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."Performance Document"."Performance Document Period Name" s_3,
   ("Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."Time"."Calendar Year" + 1) s_4,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."Worker"."Employee Name" s_5,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."Worker"."Person ID" s_6
FROM "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time") Performance,

(SELECT
   0 s_0,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."-  Performance Rating Level"."Numeric Rating" s_1,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."-  Performance Rating Level"."Rating Short Description" s_2,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."Performance Document"."Performance Document Period Name" s_3,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."Time"."Calendar Year" s_4,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."Worker"."Employee Name" s_5,
   "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time"."Worker"."Person ID" s_6
FROM "Workforce Performance - Performance Rating Distribution Real Time") Performance2

Where Promotions.s_7 = performance.s_6
and  Promotions.s_7 = performance2.s_6
and Promotions.s_3 = performance.s_4
and  Promotions.s_3 = performance2.s_4
